help:
❓ How it works

✍️ Confess — pick a category, send your text, confirm. A moderator reviews it; it appears in the channel as #N and you are notified.
📝 My confessions — status of what you sent, delete your own posts.
📢 Advertise — buy a sponsored post.
📜 Rules — what is allowed; request a takedown.

Commands: /delete <number> · /lang · /cancel

Everything is anonymous: your Telegram ID is never stored.
